title: Fundamental inequality dim R <= dim m/m^2, with equality iff regular
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with Krull dimension $\dim R$. Then $\dim_\kappa\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$ is finite and $\dim R\le\dim_\kappa\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$; and $R$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] (its maximal ideal can be generated by $\dim R$ elements) if and only if $\dim_\kappa\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2=\dim R$.
